name: daily-english-lab
description: Daily English Lab — monorepo root. Run `npm run dev` to start all services.

scripts.dev: concurrently --names "FRONTEND,BACKEND,AI-SVC" --prefix-colors "blue.bold,magenta.bold,cyan.bold" --prefix "[{name}]" --kill-others-on-fail --handle-input "npm --prefix apps/frontend run dev" "npm --prefix apps/backend run start:dev" "npm --prefix apps/ai-service run dev"
scripts.build: concurrently --names "FRONTEND,BACKEND" --prefix-colors "blue.bold,magenta.bold" --prefix "[{name}]" "npm --prefix apps/frontend run build" "npm --prefix apps/backend run build"
scripts.install:all: npm install && npm --prefix apps/frontend install && npm --prefix apps/backend install && pip install -r apps/ai-service/requirements.txt
scripts.lint: concurrently --names "FRONTEND,BACKEND" --prefix-colors "blue.bold,magenta.bold" --prefix "[{name}]" "npm --prefix apps/frontend run lint" "npm --prefix apps/backend run lint"
